_comment: The operating system sandbox for the agent's Bash commands (harness/core/scripts/sandbox_config.py writes it into .claude/settings.json; skill harness-sandbox walks through it). Off until the project lists what its work needs from the network: allowed_domains starts with code hosting and package registries; sandbox_config.py --suggest lists the hosts the agent used. Retrying a command outside the sandbox is always closed. Paths: ~/ is the home folder, ./ the project root. Turning it on or changing it is a change of the agent's boundaries: a task contract and a human yes.
_required: true: Claude Code refuses to start when the sandbox cannot run (failIfUnavailable), and the ConfigChange hook blocks switching it off.
_deny_read: Credentials of the machine. Add the project's secret folders ("./secrets/") when no script the agent runs needs them; a deploy script that loads secrets then runs outside the agent or as an excluded command.
_excluded_commands: Commands that run outside the sandbox, with the full rights of the user (e.g. "docker compose *"): only tools that cannot work inside it.
